The '''noticeboard''' is located in [[Watson's house]]. Upon clicking it, it opens up an interface in which players can check where all [[STASH|STASH unit]] locations are, and whether they have built and filled them.

A [[S.t.a.s.h chart]] can be built to display the same information in the [[study]] in a [[player-owned house]].
